details.description:
Pulse, the captivating hard-boiled candy from the DS group, has taken the market by storm since its launch in 2015. This category-defying treat offers a unique and alluring experience, beginning with a burst of fruity flavour and culminating in a tantalising tangy surprise. Available in five delectable varieties - Kachcha Aam, Guava, Orange, Litchi, and Pineapple - each Pulse candy delivers a mouth-watering blend of sweetness and tanginess that is truly irresistible.
Crafted with the finest ingredients, the Pulse Guava Candy Mono Carton in particular boasts an authentic guava flavour, enhanced by a harmonious blend of spices and seasonings that create a long-lasting, sweet and spicy taste. Conveniently packaged in a pyramid design, these candies are the perfect on-the-go snacking option, providing a premium indulgence experience anytime, anywhere.
details.ingredients: SUGAR, LIQUIDgLUCOSE, DEXTROSE, MIXED MASALA (4%), ACIDITY REGULATORS (INS 330, INS 296, INS 331-iii), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (GUAVA FLAVOUR), COLOUR (INS 129)

nutritionalInfo.RDA: Percentage (%) contribution to Recommended Dietary Allowance (RDA) calculated on the basis of 2000 Kcal energy requirement for average adult per day

details.storageInstructions:
*Store in a cool and dry place
*Keep away from direct sunlight

details.description: Pulse Kachcha Aam Candy offers a delightful burst of tangy raw mango flavour with every bite. Combining a sweet and sour taste, these hard-boiled candies create a unique snacking experience that is loved by all age groups. Conveniently packed for sharing or enjoying on the go, Pulse Kachcha Aam Candy is a fun and flavourful treat that brings the refreshing taste of raw mango to your everyday moments.
details.ingredients: Sugar, Liquid Glucose, Dextrose, Mixed Masala (4%), Acidity Regulators (INS 330, INS 296, INS 331(iii)), Nature-Identical Flavouring Substances (Kachcha Aam Flavour), Colours (INS 102, INS 133).
details.storageInstructions:
Store in a cool and dry place.
Keep away from direct sunlight.

details.description: Pass Pass Litchi With Tangy Twist Flavoured Candies offer a delightful combination of sweet litchi flavour with a refreshing tangy twist. Conveniently packed and easy to carry, these flavourful candies are perfect for sharing, gifting or enjoying anytime you crave a sweet and tangy indulgence.

details.description: Pass Pass Pulse – Candy with a Tangy Twist comes in an assorted pack featuring a mix of bold and vibrant flavours. Each candy offers a surprising burst of tanginess, making it a fun treat for those who enjoy a twist in every bite. Conveniently packed, it is perfect for sharing, gifting or enjoying anytime you fancy something flavourful.

Pulse Golmol Imli Pyramid Pack offers a playful twist with its tangy tamarind flavour and surprising burst of spices. It's perfect for enjoying on the go or sharing with friends. Each piece delivers a fun mix of sweet, sour, and spicy notes, making it a delightful treat for tamarind lovers.
details.ingredients: Each (3.5 g) Goli Contains: Imli (Tamarindus indica, Fruit) 525.0 mg, Chhuhara (Phoenix dactylifera, Fruit) 210.0 mg, Gur (Saccharum officinarum, Pulp, Powder) 140.0 mg, Neembusat (Citrus medica Extract, Fruit, Powder) 52.5 mg, Kishmish (Vitis vinifera Linn., Fruit) 70.0 mg, Sugar q.s., Salt q.s.
